tags: @guarantee ok.format a number is formatted like `format` (60000 gives "1m", 120000 "2m", -180000 "-3m")
@guarantee ok.long with `long` true a number is written out (60000 gives "1 minute", 120000 "2 minutes", -180000 "-3 minutes", 36000000 "10 hours")

@guarantee ok.units accepts the units years, year, yrs, yr, y; months, month, mo; weeks, week, w; days, day, d; hours, hour, hrs, hr, h; minutes, minute, mins, min, m; seconds, second, secs, sec, s; milliseconds, millisecond, msecs, msec, ms
@guarantee ok.values a year is 31557600000 ms, a day 86400000, an hour 3600000, a minute 60000, a second 1000 ("1h" gives 3600000)
@guarantee ok.case units may be lowercase, uppercase or capitalised, with or without a space before them
@guarantee ok.default-unit a number with no unit is milliseconds ("100" gives 100, "-200" gives -200)
@guarantee ok.fraction fractional and negative values are accepted ("0.5m", "-0.5m", ".5m", "-.5m")
@guarantee ok.short formats milliseconds in the largest fitting unit with a short suffix (2000 gives "2s", 60000 gives "1m", 36000000 gives "10h")
@guarantee ok.long with `long` true writes the unit out, plural when the value is not 1 (60000 gives "1 minute", 120000 "2 minutes")
@guarantee ok.negative a negative value keeps its sign (-180000 gives "-3m")
